note: Wharton State Forest's developed family campground by Atsion Lake. The sites NJ Outdoors marks waterfront (AFC 04, 06, 08, 10, 12, 20, 22) sit about 25-40 m from the lake behind a band of shoreline trees. NJ Outdoors lists every site at a 22-ft maximum equipment length (a 23-ft search finds none), which may be a booking-system value rather than measured pads; confirm fit with the park before booking. --Claude
